sections.content: We are always excited to connect with those interested in joining us on our mission to squash industrial emissions. Whether you are looking for a full-time role or internship, drop us a line! If a role opens up and you are a good fit, we will be in touch!

sections.heading: About Sesame Sustainability
sections.content: At Sesame Sustainability we are developing simulation, optimization, and analysis software to accelerate cost-optimal decarbonization across heavy industry (responsible for over 40% of global emissions). Borne from research at the MIT Energy Initiative, our technology stack is tried, tested, and trusted by some of the largest players in energy and environment.
